description: Deletes a folder. An empty one just goes; one with pages is refused (folder_not_empty, listing them) unless withPages is true, which deletes every page under it with its route and file (template sites; ask the user first, and dryRun lists them). A folder holding a collection's items is refused: move or delete the collection first. Saved at once, like every edit in Xodia; pushing to Git and publishing stay the user's. The site plan follows in the same change.

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

dryRun.description: Only list the pages it holds; deletes nothing

withPages.description: Also delete every page under it, with their routes and files (template sites). Ask the user first

name: delete_folder
title: Delete a folder
